status: PROPOSED DESIGN ONLY; all 28 cases NOT-RUN; no approved public hashes or production compiler
scope: One canonical component package with record/enum type branches, and service interface -> existing component/operation mapping; not a second graph or type registry

outcomes.schema-accept: proposed JSON Schema structure accepts, not approved public type semantics
outcomes.schema-reject: proposed JSON Schema structure must reject
outcomes.semantic-reject: JSON shape may accept but canonical resolver/public trust must reject
outcomes.semantic-different: verified logical projection must differ on mutation, requiring different digest once hash contracts accepted
outcomes.semantic-same: verified logical projection unchanged by implementation-only mutation; provenance/build evidence still changes

cases.mutation: A canonical type entry containing kind=record and ordered fields remains valid under additive enum schema
cases.rationale: Original record package fixtures must be structurally unchanged

cases.mutation: A canonical type entry containing kind=enum and one-or-more ordered case names, without payload TypeReference
cases.rationale: Closed zero-payload enum is representable

cases.mutation: An enum variant may include a complete canonical nominal TypeReference payload
cases.rationale: Exact payload owner and digest still need semantic verification

cases.mutation: An enum variant may include a complete bounded generic TypeReference payload
cases.rationale: Acyclic template and public type meaning still unresolved

cases.mutation: An enum entry has both variants and fields
cases.rationale: No mixing record and enum authored structures

cases.mutation: A record entry has both fields and variants
cases.rationale: No mixing record and enum authored structures

cases.mutation: An enum has empty variants list
cases.rationale: Closed exported enum needs at least one case

cases.mutation: An enum variant has no name or an empty name
cases.rationale: Every variant has a source name

cases.mutation: An enum variant has unexpected executable/native fields
cases.rationale: Schema does not encode runtime implementation or ABI

cases.mutation: An enum variant uses null instead of absent optional typeRef
cases.rationale: Unit/no-payload and null are not interchangeable

cases.mutation: A type entry has kind=service
cases.rationale: Service maps to existing components and operations, not public type kind

cases.mutation: A package type entry has kind=unknown
cases.rationale: Unknown public kind fails closed

cases.mutation: An enum has two NFC-equivalent or duplicate case names
cases.rationale: Unique normalized variant IDs not expressible by plain JSON Schema

cases.mutation: Swap two authored enum variants without changing their names and payloads
cases.rationale: Author-order logical enum meaning changes and resulting type digest must change

cases.mutation: Add, remove, rename, or change a variant payload from absent to Unit
cases.rationale: Logical value domain and type digest change

cases.mutation: Enum payload TypeReference points to this same enum by value, including through a cycle
cases.rationale: Unbounded value recursion forbidden until separately reviewed ownership indirection

cases.mutation: Enum payload imports unverified core contract digest even when 64-hex-shaped
cases.rationale: Shape alone does not authorize public export

cases.mutation: Two types export same package-qualified typeId with record and enum kinds
cases.rationale: One namespace with no kind-overload

cases.mutation: Source service declares Read but verified component has different Result success/error type
cases.rationale: Exact typed public operation link mismatch

cases.mutation: Source service has effect device-read but package command declares no effect
cases.rationale: Undeclared effect cannot be inferred or erased

cases.mutation: Service source omits capability, source, target and retry fields and no independently locked component package exists
cases.rationale: No default native provider or trusted operation

cases.mutation: Source service is assigned type kind service and published under resolvedExports.kind=type
cases.rationale: Only existing component operation public identity is applicable

cases.mutation: Service command points to target id instead of qualified target triple
cases.rationale: Graph target reference and operation target triple are different namespaces

cases.mutation: Source interface claims native executable when package has only planned target status
cases.rationale: Qualification requires actual target-specific native evidence

cases.mutation: Enum field identifier renamed but physical target-native variant layout remains identical
cases.rationale: Logical public identity changes independently of ABI shape

cases.mutation: Reorder implementation source paths of the verified component without altering logical interface
cases.rationale: Implementation provenance changes, not logical public operation digest

cases.mutation: Operation default sideEffectClass or retryPolicy inferred from absence in AUI service interface
cases.rationale: All fields supplied and verified from canonical package, never guessed

cases.mutation: Public service interface is treated as permission for OS device-read operation
cases.rationale: Live capability and signed provider proof still required
